I re-checked the schedule against all 20 constraints and every one holds. It matches the schedule in the team note, not the "Cara in slot 4 and Ben in slot 3" option.

- Hana must come before Finn, Ivo, Gus and Ben, so she is in slot 1.
- Finn is immediately after Hana, so Finn is in slot 2.
- Exactly one person is between Cara and Hana, so Cara is in slot 3.
- Dev must come after Ann, Gus, Ivo, Finn, Hana, Cara and Ben, so Dev is in slot 8 or 9. With Dev in slot 9, Elif is in slot 7 (one person between them).
- Ann and Ivo must be at least 3 slots apart, and Ann and Finn must be at least 3 slots apart. That puts Ann in slot 5, Gus in slot 6 and Ivo in slot 8, which leaves Ben in slot 4.

I didn't check whether this is the only solution.
